gpu_selected_reference.scope: Selected handle index, client lookup/liveness, NativeAdrenoVm periodic route-only check, and retained WC BO-pool design. Houji pool adapts whole CPU4K/16K ownership, bounded 256 MiB, failed-conversion retention and existing fence/CPU lease/TLB retirement; disabled unless gpool is explicit. Retain houji 4096-object capacity, qualified cache policy, ASID-unmap selection and context-reset semantics

gpu_coherence_reference.scope: coherenceProbe two-way dirty-source and clean-resident experiment adapted to exclusive CPU16K scratch; mode 4 stops after proof, private mode 5 additionally requires eight fixed WB-target readbacks before a bounded coherent-import desktop trial; NC imports retain maintenance

network_stack_reference.scope: IONetworkStack service/open lifecycle only, with administrator-only client and builtin IOResources matching; no Wi-Fi driver or MAC properties

display_completion_reference.scope: Completion notification and retained-frame lifecycle reference only. Houji adapts existing ABI fence observations to wake its bounded CPU-copy worker; rechecks producer and current tail, holds issuer lock through copy, and retains timer fallback. No upstream GPU scanout, GPU IRQ or panel vblank implementation is claimed.

gpu_interaction_reference.scope: First-frame touch/wake headroom reference. Houji uses one 50 ms prewarm at 60% of its effective factory/thermal cap for a fresh input burst after idle; continuous input cannot renew this pulse. Retains existing active-load, wake and thermal policy; does not adopt sheng's one-second maximum-frequency touch hold.

gpu_unmap_reference.scope: Retain upstream page and whole-ASID paths; houji selects existing whole-ASID plus TLBSYNC for all native VM unmaps because each guarded page write repeats GPU idle MMIO; r249 measured long unmap transactions. Does not remove completion, publication or quarantine.

battery_reference.scope: Copied portable codecs and host tests; adapted ADSP/GLINK/QRTR glue and battery publisher. Houji addresses and own modem_a only; no charger SET. Native firmware r261, sparse platform preflight r262, ADSP startup/IOPMPowerSource r263 and notification/diagnostic cleanup r264 verified. User-visible battery and USB plug state verified in both r263 and r264; r264 observer captured AC/Battery transitions.

battery_spi_reference.scope: GICv3 SPI routing adapted for the existing houji timer/IPI controller; only INTID 261 and 37; no redistributor reads

gpu_allocation_reference.scope: Skip optional XNU contiguous search when the qualified BO pool exists; retain explicit contiguity, legacy no-pool behavior, CPU4K/16K backing, zeroing, cache policy and VM validation. Do not adopt upstream pageable/system-BO migration or out-of-lock allocation in this candidate.

gpu_alias_workspace_reference.scope: Select VM-owned alias workspace lifetime with fixed 65536-span budget, CPU16K ownership, both preflight/live alias checks and all table verification. No exclusive map bypass or dynamic tables. r280 exposed a binding failure because upstream-style scratch attachment changed the sealed houji arena. Candidate carries scratch in synchronous call-local arena views, preserving caller metadata and the original runtime seal. Allocation remains deferred until boot qualification and pool initialization, before provider publication and known-image rounds. Actual runtime-seal regression fails before the fix and passes after; r281 reached the desktop, recorded 2227 indexed checks and 544 successful DVFS changes without failure. Maximum map duration was 8.220 ms under this workload; the user still reported laggy app animations. This is not an FPS qualification.

display_timing_reference.scope: Optional -ht read-only DSI0/INTF1 counters and inherited CTL/SSPP state after first completed GUI copy. Five one-second samples; no register writes, refresh switching or vblank implementation.

gpu_fence_poll_reference.scope: Adapt pending fence observation outside issuer lock. Houji uses only a retained exact-PA Normal-NC completion word qualified by AT before provider publication, because its normal ring acquire hook also validates MMIO state. The hint cannot authorize completion or retirement; completion, invalid/unissued fences, unavailable hints and deadlines retain locked core dispatch. Stop revokes the hint. No changes to GPU clocks, thermal policy, rendering or resource lifetime; r283 observed 99963 unlocked pending polls; user reported no animation improvement and command completion latency did not improve. No FPS or rendering qualification.

unixnu.scope: Staged app installation reference; board vnode patch not copied because original bundles already exist in the active houji Data tree.

uikittools.scope: System application database rebuild API reference; independent bounded mobile helper with per-bundle verification. Does not copy application bundles or bypass device capabilities.

system_apps_references.scope: Original 20H392 bundles restored within the verified offline image. r284 verified all 32 Launch Services registrations and original bundle bytes/inodes/owners; user confirmed Calculator and Clock open. Other app features remain unqualified; BooksWidgetExtension hit missing dyld @-path policy and graphics extensions still crash.

system_apps_dyld_reference.scope: ALLOW_AT_PATH bit only. Owner iOS16 dyld verified op 0x5a ABI and failure-to-zero behavior; original app bundles only. Independent callback; no Apple code copied, no environment/insertion/trust-cache permissions. Host regression passed; device validation pending.

turnip_whole_bo_cache_reference.scope: Historical r293 reference: the then-current houji cache was bounded to 128 entries / 64 MiB / 8 MiB per BO and adopted quarter-power size classes. Those limits do not describe the active full replacement, which uses dynamically growing records and one-second stale-entry reclamation. See docs/architecture.md and metal_frontend.replacement for current provenance. The r293 device recorded zero rounded requests and zero larger matches; the fit rules were not exercised and animation/rendering issues remained.

gpu_host_import_wait.basis: r291 animation samples and actual special BoImport branch in NativeAdrenoPublish.cpp
gpu_host_import_wait.scope: Route host imports through the existing zero-timeout readiness gate and mutation reservation, sleeping outside the issuer lock. Keep original board quiescence/VM proof once ready, caller task, pinning and reply-on-success. Includes imports in existing per-method latency records; never retries a dispatched import. Host dispatch scheduler tests pass; r292 observed 1264 timed imports and user reported slight animation improvement; uncontrolled workload, no FPS qualification.

full_system_boot.flush_policy: Only exact payload-free LUN0 SYNCHRONIZE CACHE is independent of write arming; WRITE10 retains the original arm and fixed logfs range
full_system_boot.reserved_nc_policy: Current-trial HZR EFI/GCD/AT validation precedes one-time whitelist of exactly the metadata and fixed target 16K pages; WCOMB only, no padding/PIL-wide/kernel-RAM allowance; actual AT/PA checks retained
full_system_boot.terminal_screen: Existing mapped console and XNU ISO font; corrected LSB-first glyph bit order. Panic/halt up to 90 seconds within original deadline; no panic allocation, remapping, UFS I/O or UEFI return. User photo verified old mirrored panic text and matching ENOEXEC; corrected on-device orientation awaits next trial.
full_system_boot.panic_reason_record: First formatted panic or handled terminal reason in owned RAM only, with current-trial identity and CRC; initialized-empty state is distinct. Exact locator is in existing startup header. Optional next-UEFI reader defaults off; bounds/translation/identity/CRC enforced. Current Recovery path did not retain a matching record, so no error reason recovered.
full_system_boot.pid1_startup_results: Optional default-off houji_pid1_startup=1; native-root and bounded-Recovery gates. Seven normal startup results plus one reserved first critical-exit/authorized-reboot reason. PID1 exit payload is read only within the validated kernel reason buffer, before coredump/sync/panic in normal context. No periodic collector or panic I/O; arbitrary kernel panic persistence is not guaranteed. Detailed vnode/Mach-O phases additionally require houji_pid1_detail=1; the default finite profile records the three exec transitions, stock main and the reserved terminal reason.
full_system_boot.calendar_source: Fresh 64-bit host boot-epoch in chosen, consumed by GenericARMPE; unused iOS16 houji_epoch argument removed; no RTC qualification
full_system_boot.coherence_fallback: Only optional mode 5 status 11 with phase 3, valid views, eight inconclusive dirty-line attempts and no coherence work submitted. Require original idle owner, remove both probe mappings and clean/invalidate owned scratch before continuing mode 3 with coherence off. Any cleanup or other qualification failure retains terminal stop; hardware qualification pending.
full_system_boot.ADSP_carveout_writes: iOS26 only: bounded volatile aligned 32-bit stores, partial-word neighbor preservation, overflow checks; avoid bulk memcpy/bzero/DC ZVA on Device-typed reserved firmware RAM. Existing image placement/PAS/range rules and GPU NC whitelist unchanged. DTB metadata begin/accepted startup checkpoints distinguish PAS from segment writes; hardware qualification pending.
full_system_boot.filesystem_selection: houji_native_root=1 accepts only the registered hfs filesystem and refuses an alternate mountroot callback. No fallback to always-successful mockfs. RAM-only native_root=0 preserves prior filesystem selection. Mount callback type/result are printed at startup; actual HFS mount verified in full-system v14 through v16.
full_system_boot.cryptex_layout: Canonical OS/App contents in private/preboot/Cryptexes with stock System/Cryptexes symlinks. The default system shared-cache directory links to the unchanged Cryptex cache. v16 verified stock launchd main with this root layout.
full_system_boot.pid1_services_snapshot: Optional houji_pid1_services=1 with the same startup, native-root and Recovery gates. The existing main worker saves one additional record after 30 seconds. It checks five live process names and calls the existing GPU submission counter query once. A successful query gives counters at the snapshot time. The first terminal result keeps its own slot. A mode 3 worker also saves one exit-code and counter record from normal context before provider teardown. A successful bounded run with a stopped provider returns through the time-limit screen.

minimum_device_result.result: 2026-11-06 owner screen photo shows Darwin 25.6.0, initialized GIC/VM/IOKit/HFS and HOUJI IOS26 ARM64E PID1 REACHED. RAM-only one-CPU trial; no physical root install or runtime collectors.

ios26.hardware_boot_scope: Native arm64e RAM PID1 and stock iOS26 launchd main verified on Xiaomi 14. Visible desktop, Metal shaders and multicore need further device evidence.
